formerly: H-146 (renumbered 2026-11-21: id collision with ETF execution_cost_gate)

spec.universe: US SEC filers with PIT market cap in $2B-$10B at rebalance
spec.look_ahead_guard: fundamental fact usable only if filed < rebalance date (strict)
spec.cost_source: declared fallback 20bp round-trip (slippage model not importable)

top_decile_book.rule: long every in-band name with gpa_zscore >= 1.2816

limits: Universe is a random sample of CURRENTLY REGISTERED SEC filers. Firms that delisted and stopped filing entirely are under-represented, so survivorship bias is reduced but not eliminated.
Cross-section includes financials and REITs, for which GP/A is not meaningful; per-name noise dilution is not corrected.
MKT/SMB/HML/RMW are declared as the benchmark but are NOT regressed out here, so a strong factor tilt could masquerade as a signal.
GP/A is built from annual 10-K only; intra-year filing updates are not used, which lags the signal by up to a year.
